method: Each card's expectations were compared with the recorded metrics and, wherever a metric did not match the card's quantity, with values computed from the 20 Hz series (scripts in /tmp/ft-eval22/calc/): values at given times, peak values and times, first-order and exponential fits for time constants, zero crossings and extrema for periods and doubling times, parabola fits for the power-bucket minimum, and unwrapped heading. Numbers just outside a range (within about 25 % of the range width or of the bound) were graded NEAR; wrong sign or shape, or a number further out, was graded FAIL. Peak times on a flat plateau that extends into the window were not penalised. Red flags were checked one by one. Deviations in how cards were flown (F6, H8a/H8b from 4,000 ft; F1 pedal logic; T1 and F9 pilot laws) are noted where they matter.
summary: The model is configured with the correct counterclockwise rotor, and every rotation-dependent sign on the cards is right: left skid low in the hover, left pedal in the hover and right pedal in cruise and autorotation, nose right with collective, nose left at power loss, Fenestron unloading with right pedal, left-side cyclic through translational lift, and retreating-blade stall on the left with a left roll. Most dynamics land inside the author's bands. Hover roll and pitch responses to cyclic, the unstable hover phugoid (13 s period, about 5 s to double), heave with a 2.5 s time constant, translational lift, the power bucket (minimum about 63 kt), the forward-flight short period, the Dutch roll (2.5 s period, damping ratio 0.32), positive speed stability, roll control at low g and coordinated-turn kinematics are all realistic. The vortex-ring cards are a highlight: collective alone loses 843 ft with irregular 29 % thrust surges, while the classical recovery loses only 126 ft. The weak spots are in yaw and rotor-speed behaviour. In the hover power loss the rotor keeps decaying for about 2 s after the lever is fully down, with NR only 75.8 % at 5 s, which trips a red flag. Hover yaw is strongly coupled to sideways drift: cyclic pulses produce 7-9 deg/s of uncommanded yaw, and after a pedal step the yaw rate stalls at about 25 deg/s instead of decaying. The roll-in at 100 kt shows slight proverse rather than adverse yaw. Power and collective climb more steeply toward 135 kt relative to the hover than predicted (P135/Phover 1.32; collective 4.0 deg above hover). The stall roll at 140 kt is about 60 deg, larger than the predicted 5-35 deg. The model trims at about 3.5 deg sideslip with the ball centred at 80-100 kt. Two transients outside the cards are worth knowing about. In F6 the first 2.3 s after the failure produce a 34.5 deg left bank, 18 deg of nose-down pitch and -0.23 g (rotor thrust briefly negative), and the autopilot needed full aft and full right cyclic to recover. In F5 a pure +5 m/s speed step yawed the nose left and produced a 20 deg left bank within 6 s. Both are physically coherent (sideslip-driven dihedral roll, nose-down on lever reduction), but they are large.
top_findings: H7 (red flag, medium confidence): after a hover double engine failure with the lever fully down at 2.1 s, NR keeps falling at about 2.4 %/s to a minimum of 74.4 % at 4.0 s (expected 72-90 % at 1.3-2.5 s). It is still falling 1.3 s after the descent passed 2,000 fpm and is only 75.8 % at 5 s (expected 85-105 %); the rotor begins to recover only near 3,300 fpm of descent.

F1 (medium confidence): the high-speed end of the power curve is steep relative to the hover. P(135 kt)/P(hover) = 1.32 (expected 0.8-1.2) and the 135 kt collective is +4.0 deg above hover (expected at most +2.5 deg), although every absolute power point, from 442 kW in the hover (bottom of band) to 584 kW at 135 kt, is inside its band.

H4 (low confidence): after the right pedal is returned to trim at 4 s, the hover yaw rate drops from 37.9 to 27 deg/s in 1 s and then stalls at about 25 deg/s (66 % left after 2 s; fitted time constant 5.2 s against the expected 1.4-3 s), while about 2 m/s of rightward drift builds.

H2/H3 (low confidence): pure cyclic pulses in the hover produce uncommanded nose-right yaw of 8.8 deg/s (H2, at 5.5 s) and 7.4 deg/s (H3, at 6 s) against the expected |r| < 5 deg/s, growing with 2-2.4 m/s of lateral drift. The hover yaw axis looks strongly coupled to sideways drift.

F3 (low confidence): the yaw during the 100 kt roll-in is proverse (r up to +1.2 deg/s nose right) instead of the adverse nose-left yaw expected from the identified EC135 Np < 0. The turn rate at 4-8 s (0.9-1.4 deg/s) is at the bottom of the expected +1..+5 deg/s.

F7 (low confidence on magnitude): the retreating-blade-stall roll is in the right direction but very large, p -57.5 deg/s and a phi change of -59.5 deg at 2.7 s against the predicted -5..-35 deg, with about 41 % of the disc staying stalled for 2.6 s after the stick returns.
F9/trim (medium confidence): with the ball centred the model flies at +3.4..+3.8 deg sideslip in level flight at 80-100 kt and +3.55 deg in the 30 deg turn, against the expected |beta| <= 3 deg.

F6 (minor): the NR minimum (83.7 %) comes at 2.85 s instead of 1.2-2.5 s because of the pilot's pull-up from -0.23 g. Steady autorotation NR is 110.75 %, above the 106 % power-off limit for the whole of 5.6-40 s (inside the card's 95-112 % band).

cards.headline: The hover trim looks right for a real EC135: left skid low, slightly nose up, left pedal, about 440 kW and rotor speed at 100 %.

expectations.observed: phi = -3.44 deg (steady over 5 s).
expectations.comment: Left skid low, inside -4.5..-1.0. This confirms the model's rotor turns counterclockwise like the real aircraft.

expectations.observed: theta = +3.13 deg.
expectations.comment: Inside +1..+6.

expectations.observed: Total 442.2 kW; main rotor 385.0 kW; Fenestron 37.2 kW.
expectations.comment: Total is at the very bottom of 440-570. Main rotor is inside 380-470. The Fenestron is slightly under the author's 40-70 kW sub-band. This low hover power feeds into the F1.3 ratio.

expectations.observed: ped = -0.384 (left of centre). Every forward-flight trim pedal is to the right of it: T1 40 kt -0.259, F1 40 kt -0.211, 60-135 kt +0.21..+0.45.
expectations.comment: Inside -0.7..+0.05, and it satisfies the firm relative part.

expectations.observed: col = 0.552 of range.
expectations.comment: Inside 0.5-0.8.

cards.headline: Right stick gives a right roll of the right size, then the expected dihedral swing-back, but the nose also wanders right by almost 9 deg/s in yaw with no pedal input.

expectations.observed: p peaks at +8.3 deg/s at 0.45 s, then droops to +6.6 deg/s by 1.0 s while the stick is still held. A first-order fit gives tau = 0.20 s with a 0.06 s delay.
expectations.comment: Magnitude and rise time match. The peak comes about 0.25 s earlier than the expected 0.7-1.15 s because p sags about 20 % during the hold, probably as dihedral builds with the sideways drift (v = 0.5 m/s at 1 s).

expectations.observed: phi peaks at +7.2 deg at 1.25-1.3 s. After release p reaches zero in about 0.3 s, then reverses to -2.5 deg/s at 1.5 s. phi is still +6.8 at 1.5 s and +4.9 at 2.3 s.
expectations.comment: Peak inside 6-12 at 1.2-2 s. There is no attitude spring-back within 1 s. The later decrease is the dihedral effect that H2.3 predicts.

expectations.observed: Lateral ground speed peaks at +2.25 m/s at 3.45 s (body v +2.37 m/s at 3.6 s). phi passes through zero at 3.7 s and is -7.1 deg relative to trim at 6 s, 14.3 deg below the peak.
expectations.comment: Inside 1.5-4 m/s at 2-4 s. This is the start of the hover lateral oscillation, as predicted, and it is already growing: the -7.1 deg swing exceeds the +7.2 peak.

expectations.observed: |q| peaks at 1.55 deg/s at 0.75 s (19 % of p_peak). delta theta is +2.3 deg at 3 s (it grows to +6.0 deg by 6 s, outside the window).
expectations.comment: Inside <=5 deg/s and <=5 deg.

expectations.observed: r grows steadily from 0.4 deg/s at 1.4 s to 8.85 deg/s at 5.5 s, exceeding 5 deg/s from 3.1 s. The heading changes by +28 deg in 6 s.
expectations.comment: 77 % over the 5 deg/s bound (low confidence). The yaw builds with the rightward drift, which suggests a strong yaw response to sideways drift in hover (H3 shows 7.4 deg/s too). The sign (nose right while drifting right) is physically plausible.

cards.headline: Forward stick pitches the nose down by the expected amount, speed builds, and the nose comes back up through trim (the hover phugoid starts), as a hingeless helicopter should.

expectations.observed: q peaks at -9.94 deg/s at 1.0 s and is still just building at release. A first-order fit gives tau = 0.42 s with a 0.08 s delay.
expectations.comment: Peak and timing are inside -13..-5 at 0.9-1.2 s. The pitch time constant of 0.42 s is just below the stated 0.45-0.85 s.

expectations.observed: theta minimum -9.6 deg at 1.7 s, i.e. 0.7 s after the stick returns.
Forward speed peaks at 3.75 m/s (body u; ground 3.66 m/s) at 3.9-4.0 s. The nose returns through trim at 4.0 s; theta is +11.7 deg at 6 s.
expectations.comment: Inside 2-7 m/s at 3-5.5 s. The nose is up at 6 s as predicted. The swing is strongly divergent (+11.7 deg after -9.6 deg).

expectations.observed: |p| peaks at 2.85 deg/s at 0.6 s (29 % of |q|). delta phi is +2.7 deg at 3 s.
expectations.comment: Inside <=6 deg/s, <=60 % of |q| and <=6 deg.

cards.headline: Right pedal turns the nose right at a believable rate and unloads the Fenestron, but after the pedal is centred the yaw rate stops decaying and stays near 25 deg/s.

expectations.observed: r = +17.1 deg/s at 1 s, +24.4 at 2 s and +37.9 at 4 s. It is still rising at 4 s at about 6.6 deg/s^2. The initial yaw acceleration is about 22 deg/s^2 (0.38 rad/s^2).
expectations.comment: All three values are inside their bands and the sign is right.

expectations.observed: Heading change at 6 s is +151 deg. After release at 4 s, r falls 37.9 -> 27.0 deg/s in 1 s (equivalent tau 2.9 s), then only 27.0 -> 25.1 in the next second (equivalent tau 14 s). An exponential fit over 4-6 s gives tau = 5.2 s, with 66 % of the release rate left after 2 s. There is no oscillation.
expectations.comment: The heading change is inside 40-250, but the decay is far slower than 1.4-3 s and looks like a plateau (low confidence). The rate holds while about 2 m/s of rightward drift builds, which fits the drift-driven yaw seen in H2/H3.

expectations.observed: Fenestron power falls from 37.2 to 27.2 kW (-26.8 %, -10 kW). Total power falls 2.0 % at 1 s and 5.6 % at 4 s.
expectations.comment: Inside -45..-15 %, with the sign expected for a counterclockwise rotor.

expectations.observed: Max |delta phi| = 1.85 deg (to the right); max |Vz| = 164 fpm (descending); NR 99.41-100.55 %. Not on the card: theta rises +5.9 deg by 6 s.
expectations.comment: All three are inside their bounds. The roll sign is opposite to the author's 'most likely' left, which was not a firm prediction.

cards.headline: Raising the collective makes the helicopter climb with a realistic lag, yaws the nose right as a counterclockwise rotor should, and the rotor speed barely droops.

expectations.observed: Upward acceleration peaks at 1.19 m/s^2 at 0.1 s, then decays (exponential tau 2.5 s). Vz is +258 fpm at 2 s and +434 fpm at 6 s. A first-order fit gives tau = 2.54 s and Vss = 486 fpm.
expectations.comment: Inside 0.8-1.6 m/s^2 and 250-700 fpm. The heave time constant sits at the lower edge of 2.5-5 s.

expectations.observed: r = +15.7 deg/s at 2 s and +25.6 deg/s at 6 s, nose right and building steadily.
expectations.comment: Inside 8-50, sign correct.

expectations.observed: Power is +10.5 % at 0.2 s, +9.9 % at 1 s and +8.6 % at 6 s.
expectations.comment: Inside 8-22 %.

expectations.observed: NR minimum 99.65 % (0.35 % droop) at 0.5 s. It is back to 100 % by 1.2 s, overshoots to 100.25 %, and is 100.02 % at 5 s.
expectations.comment: Inside 0.3-3 % and recovered well within 5 s.

cards.headline: Left alone in the hover, the model drifts into a slowly growing pitch-and-roll oscillation with a period of about 13 s: the classic unstable hover phugoid.

expectations.observed: theta extrema relative to trim: +0.79 (1.0 s), -1.42 (7.55 s), +3.57 (14.2 s), -9.37 (20.55 s), and +14.3 deg at 25 s.
expectations.comment: Oscillatory and divergent.

expectations.observed: Zero crossings at 3.76, 10.19, 17.02 and 22.91 s give half-periods of 6.4, 6.8 and 5.9 s. The period from extrema is 13.0-13.2 s.
expectations.comment: Inside 7-16 s.

expectations.observed: Successive extrema grow by 2.5-2.6x per half cycle, so the time to double is 4.6-5.0 s.
expectations.comment: Inside 3-30 s, near the bottom of the central 5-12 s.

expectations.observed: theta peaks at +0.785 deg at 1.0 s. u turns negative (backwards: -0.09 m/s at 1 s, -0.31 at 3.5 s). The nose passes down through trim at 3.8 s, and later swings exceed the first.
expectations.comment: The sequence is right. The first nose-up peak is marginally below the 0.8-2.0 deg band, and the trim crossing comes slightly before ~4 s.

expectations.observed: |phi| exceeds 1 deg from 9.0 s and reaches 10.8 deg at 23 s. |v| reaches 4.5 m/s at 25 s.
expectations.comment: A coupled pitch-roll motion that grows.

cards.headline: At a hover power loss the nose swings left hard as expected, but after the lever is fully down the rotor keeps slowing for another 2 s and is still only 76 % at 5 s.

expectations.observed: r = -85.5 deg/s at 1.0 s (initial yaw acceleration about -117 deg/s^2), -123.5 at 2 s, levelling at about -152 deg/s from 4 s. The heading change by 5 s is -592 deg.
expectations.comment: Nose left, inside -100..-40, still growing afterwards, and well over 120 deg.

expectations.observed: NR decays at 16-17 %/s initially; NR(0.5 s) = 92.0 %, NR(1.0 s) = 85.4 %.
expectations.comment: Inside 10-22 %/s and 78-90 %.

expectations.observed: The decay rate drops from -12 %/s at 1.0 s to -2.9 %/s at 2.0 s as the lever goes down (full down at 2.1 s, NR 78.2 %). NR then keeps falling at about 2.4 %/s and reaches its minimum of 74.4 % at 4.0 s, with descent at 3,330 fpm. NR is 75.8 % at 5 s, rising at 1.8 %/s. The rotor still absorbs about 43 kW from 2.2 to 2.8 s.
expectations.comment: The minimum value is inside 72-90 %, but it comes at 4.0 s instead of 1.3-2.5 s. NR at 5 s is 75.8 % against 85-105 %, 9 points below the band (medium confidence). The rotor only starts to autorotate once the descent passes about 3,300 fpm.

expectations.observed: Downward acceleration is 0.19 g at 1.0 s, peaks at 0.63 g at 1.65 s, stays at about 0.6 g until 3.0 s, then falls to 0.19 g at 5 s. Descent at 5 s is 3,876 fpm.

red_flags_seen: NR still falling after the lever is fully down and a descent above ~2,000 fpm is established: descent passes 2,000 fpm at 2.75 s with NR 76.6 %, and NR keeps falling to 74.4 % at 4.0 s (3,330 fpm).

cards.headline: In the vortex ring, adding collective alone does not stop the sink: the descent increases to over 3,000 fpm, thrust surges irregularly, and 843 ft are lost in 20 s.

expectations.observed: Entry -1,790 fpm (ring depth 0.94). After collective +0.15 the descent increases: -2,678 fpm at 5 s, worst -3,194 fpm at about 7.6 s, -2,681 at 10 s, -2,066 at 19.5 s, -1,830 at 20 s. It never climbs.
expectations.comment: Over 1,000 fpm at 5 s and stays inside 1,200-4,000 fpm.

expectations.observed: Altitude falls from 1,196.3 m to 939.3 m, i.e. 843 ft in 20 s.
expectations.comment: Inside 300-1,500 ft.

expectations.observed: From 2 to 19.5 s rotor thrust ranges 20.7-27.7 kN, about 29 % peak-to-peak of the 24.5 kN mean. nz runs 0.85-1.15 g. Peaks come at about 3, 9 and 14.5 s and troughs at about 0.5, 5.5, 11-12.5 and 16 s (period about 5.5-6 s). There is a burst to 32.2 kN (1.31 g) at 20 s. Pitch, roll and yaw wander only slightly (phi -2.5..-5.5 deg) because the position-holding pilot is active.
expectations.comment: Inside 10-40 % with an irregular period near the upper end of 1-6 s.

expectations.observed: Power rises from 389 kW to 560-587 kW, above the 442 kW hover power. NR stays at 98.7-100.7 %.
expectations.comment: Above hover power, and the engines did not saturate, so there is no significant NR droop.

cards.headline: The classical recovery (nose down for speed plus collective) gets out of the vortex ring in about 5 s with only 126 ft lost, far better than collective alone.

expectations.observed: Horizontal airspeed passes 15 kt at 4.15 s and 22 kt at about 6.0 s. The ring depth falls to 0.15 at 4 s and 0 at 5 s.
expectations.comment: Inside 3-6 s.

expectations.observed: Vz is above -500 fpm at 4.75 s and positive from 5.85 s. It climbs at +861 fpm at 10 s.
expectations.comment: Inside 4-10 s, with a climb well within 12 s.

expectations.observed: Worst sink -1,998 fpm. Altitude minimum 1,157.9 m against 1,196.3 m at entry, i.e. 126 ft lost.
expectations.comment: Inside 80-400 ft.

expectations.observed: Height lost: H8b 126 ft against H8a 843 ft (6.7x less). Time to climb: H8b 5.85 s; H8a never climbs.
expectations.comment: Clearly ordered as expected (high confidence).

cards.headline: Accelerating from the hover to 40 kt shows translational lift, more forward stick, a little left stick, right pedal and less collective, all as expected.

expectations.observed: Power is 442 kW at 0-5 kt, 432 at 10, 415 at 15, 394 at 20, 373 at 25, 353 at 30, 336 at 35 and 326 at 40 kt. The steepest fall is 15-30 kt (about 4 kW/kt). P(40)/P(hover) = 0.741. It settles at 289 kW (0.65) after the acceleration ends.
expectations.comment: Inside 0.55-0.80, with the drop concentrated through ETL.

expectations.observed: lon goes from -0.370 to -0.139 at 40 kt (+0.231 forward), increasing monotonically with speed.
theta goes from +3.12 in the hover to about -0.1..-0.55 during the acceleration, a change of -3.2 to -3.7 deg.
expectations.comment: Inside -6..-2 deg.
Left, magnitude inside -0.25..-0.02. Most of the change happens through 5-25 kt. It is more a lasting trim shift than a transient bump: it does not return toward the hover value by 40 kt.

expectations.observed: ped goes from -0.384 to -0.263 at 40 kt (+0.121 right), mostly from 10 kt onward.
expectations.comment: Inside +0.05..+0.5, direction right.

expectations.observed: col goes from 0.552 to 0.441 at 40 kt (-0.111 of range, about -1.6 deg), falling with power.
expectations.comment: Inside -0.28..-0.10, near the small end.

cards.headline: The power curve has the right bucket shape and minimum-power speed, but power and collective rise more steeply toward 135 kt, relative to the hover, than expected.

expectations.observed: Power 442/297/251/274/340/457/584 kW at 0/40/60/80/100/120/135 kt. A parabola through 40-80 kt puts the minimum at 63 kt and 250 kW. Pmin/Phover = 0.57.
expectations.comment: Bucket with its minimum inside 55-85 kt and the ratio inside 0.45-0.65. Steep rise above 100 kt.
All seven points are in band, but hover sits at the bottom edge and 120-135 kt in the upper part.

10 % above the 0.8-1.2 band. The absolute 135 kt power is in band; the ratio is high because hover power is at the bottom of its band and high-speed power near the top. 584 kW at 2500 kg also exceeds the 566 kW MCP quoted for a heavier aircraft cruising at about 137 kt.

expectations.observed: theta relative to hover: -0.8 (40), -2.4 (60), -3.8 (80), -5.4 (100), -7.0 (120), -8.1 deg (135 kt), monotonically more nose-down.
expectations.comment: 60, 100 and 135 kt are all inside their bands.

expectations.observed: col 0.552/0.413/0.394/0.436/0.531/0.681/0.829. The minimum is at 60 kt (parabola fit 56 kt), 0.158 of range (2.3 deg) below hover. At 135 kt col is 0.277 of range (+4.0 deg) above hover.
expectations.comment: The bucket, its location and its depth all pass. The 135 kt end-point is +4.0 deg against the -1.5..+2.5 deg bound, 1.5 deg beyond the bound and beyond the ~1 deg NEAR margin (medium confidence). The BO-105 analogue gives about +3.1 deg at 135 kt.

expectations.observed: ped relative to hover: +0.17 (40 kt), +0.59 (60), +0.70 (80), +0.81 (100), +0.84 (120), +0.81 (135). The 60-135 kt variation (0.24) is smaller than the 0-60 kt change (0.59).
expectations.comment: Right of hover at every speed, most right at 120 kt. Pedal logic as flown: nose on the flight path at 40 kt, ball centred from 80 kt.

cards.headline: A small fore-aft stick doublet at 100 kt gives a crisp, well-damped pitch response with modest load-factor changes and almost no speed change.

expectations.observed: q minimum -3.19 deg/s at 0.6 s; positive peak +4.70 deg/s at 1.6 s.
expectations.comment: Inside -6..-2 and +2..+5.

expectations.observed: theta minimum -2.56 deg at 1.2 s. It crosses trim at about 1.9 s, overshoots to +1.1 at 2.4 s, is +0.49 at 3 s and +0.18 at 8 s. No divergence.
expectations.comment: Inside -5..-1.5 at 1.0-1.6 s. Back near trim by 2.5-3 s with negligible drift.

expectations.observed: nz minimum 0.845 g at 0.95 s; maximum 1.139 g at 2.0 s.
Max |delta IAS| = 0.64 kt. |p| peaks at 2.18 deg/s against |q| at 4.70 deg/s.
expectations.comment: Speed change under 5 kt, and roll coupling smaller than pitch.

cards.headline: Right stick at 100 kt gives the expected right roll and a bank that persists, but the nose initially yaws slightly right (proverse) instead of left (adverse).

expectations.observed: p plateaus at +10.5..+10.7 deg/s from 0.6 to 1.0 s (max 10.70 at 0.65 s).
expectations.comment: Inside 6-13. The plateau value lies within the 0.7-1.1 s window.

expectations.observed: phi change: +10.35 deg peak at 1.4 s, +7.5 at 3-4.4 s, +6.8 at 6 s, +5.5 at 8 s (decay tau about 13 s from 4 to 8 s).
expectations.comment: Inside +5..+13 and no rapid return. The spiral looks mildly stable rather than neutral or unstable.

expectations.observed: During the roll-in r is POSITIVE: +0.8 at 0.2 s, +1.23 at 0.4 s, +0.84 at 0.6 s (beta falls 0.43 deg). The nose-left r of -1.1 deg/s appears only at 1.2-1.5 s, after the stick returns. r is +0.89 (4 s), +1.36 (5 s), +1.19 (6 s) and +0.99 deg/s (8 s).
expectations.comment: The initial yaw has the wrong sign: proverse instead of the adverse yaw implied by the identified EC135 Np < 0 (low confidence). The later turn rate is at the bottom edge of +1..+5 (0.89 at 4 s) and below the coordinated rate for the bank.

expectations.observed: Sideslip first dips -0.43 deg, then rises to +1.54 deg above the +3.41 deg trim at 1.9-2.0 s. It then oscillates (-0.19 at 3.4 s, +0.27 at 5 s; period about 3 s).
expectations.comment: Positive toward the low wing, inside +1..+7, with a Dutch-roll ripple inside 2.5-4.5 s.

expectations.observed: |q| peaks at 1.64 deg/s at 0.65 s (15 % of p).
expectations.comment: Inside <=8 deg/s and <=60 % of p.

cards.headline: The pedal doublet at 100 kt excites a Dutch roll of about 2.5 s period that dies out within about two cycles, with roll following sideslip the right way.

expectations.comment: Inside +4..+15 (at the low edge) and -4..-18.

expectations.observed: beta changes by -3.13 deg at 1.05 s, then reverses to +4.1 deg at 2.1-2.25 s.
expectations.comment: Inside -7..-1.5.

expectations.observed: r extrema after release: +6.97 (2.7 s), -2.41 (3.95 s), +0.86 (5.25 s), -0.24 (6.45 s). Period 2.5-2.55 s; half-cycle amplitude ratio 0.28-0.35, so damping ratio about 0.32. About 1.5 cycles are visible.
expectations.comment: Period at the lower edge of 2.5-4.5 s and damping at the upper end of 0.05-0.35. Better damped than Kampa's 'low Dutch-roll damping' suggests.

expectations.observed: phi rises to +3.96 deg while beta is negative, then falls to -1.48 deg while beta is positive. p is roughly in phase with -beta and phi lags about a quarter period. Swing -1.5..+4.0 deg; |p|/|r| 0.6-0.95.
expectations.comment: Dihedral sign correct, amplitude inside 1-6 deg, ratio inside 0.3-2.

expectations.observed: Heading change at 12 s is +1.3 deg.
expectations.comment: Inside <8 deg.

cards.headline: A sudden speed increase at 80 kt raises the nose and starts a gentle climb, so the model is speed-stable as it should be. It also yaws left and rolls into a 20-degree left bank, which the card did not cover.

expectations.observed: q = +1.5 deg/s at 0.25 s and +2.25 at 0.5 s; theta +2.0 deg at 2 s.
expectations.comment: Nose up within 2 s (high confidence).

expectations.observed: q peaks at +2.25 deg/s at 0.5 s (about +2.2 at 0.6 s). theta peaks at +2.07 deg at about 2.5 s, then falls back to -1.75 at 10 s as the aircraft banks left (q stays at +0.7 deg/s).
expectations.comment: q is inside 0.5-7. The theta rise is at the bottom of +2..+20. The later attitude history is dominated by the uncommanded left bank.

expectations.observed: Vz peaks at +397 fpm at 3.75-4 s, then falls to -91 fpm at 10 s.
expectations.comment: Inside 300-2,000 fpm.

expectations.observed: IAS falls from 89.5 kt to 81.3 kt at 10 s.
expectations.comment: Inside 70-84 kt (above the 'most likely below 80').

cards.headline: After a double engine failure at 100 kt the nose yaws left, the rotor dips to 84 % and recovers, and the steady autorotation at 65 kt sinks at about 2,200 fpm with right pedal, all as expected. The entry is violent, though, and settled rotor speed sits above the 106 % limit.

expectations.observed: r peaks at -27.6 deg/s at 0.55 s. beta rises from +3.4 to +24.0 deg at 1.3 s (+20.6 change).
expectations.comment: Nose left, inside -50..-10 at 0.5-1.5 s. Sideslip build-up inside +5..+25.

expectations.observed: Initial decay 11.5-12.5 %/s; NR(1.0 s) = 90.5 %. A first dip to 87.2 % at 2.0 s, then a second decay during the pilot's full-aft-cyclic recovery to a minimum of 83.7 % at 2.85 s. NR then rises to 111.3 % at 7.75 s and settles at 110.75 % (30-40 s).
expectations.comment: Values are inside 6-15 %/s, 85-94 %, 82-93 % (minimum) and 95-112 % (steady). The minimum comes 0.35 s after the 1.2-2.5 s window, driven by the pilot's pull-up from -0.23 g. NR stays above the 106 % power-off limit from 5.6 s to the end, which the author anticipated.

expectations.observed: Steady 30-40 s: -2,212 fpm at 65.0 KIAS (horizontal 64.2 kt).
expectations.comment: Inside 1,400-2,300 fpm. Flown at 4,000 ft rather than 1,000 ft; the lower density adds a few percent to the sink rate.

expectations.observed: Steady pedal +0.82 against +0.41 powered trim: 0.41 of travel further right, and right of centre.
expectations.comment: Direction and size as expected.

expectations.observed: Lever is full down at 2.0 s. Vz is within 10 % of steady from 12.55 s and NR within 1 % of steady from 19.75 s, i.e. 10.5 s and 17.75 s after the lever.
expectations.comment: Inside 10-20 s.

cards.headline: A hard pull at 140 kt stalls the retreating (left) side of the disc. The aircraft pitches up, load factor flattens near 2 g and it rolls left, all in the right directions, but the roll is much larger than predicted.

expectations.observed: nz rises to 1.42 g at stall onset (0.5 s), 1.70 g at 0.8 s and 1.74 g at 1.0 s. It then creeps to a peak of 2.01 g at 1.9 s (rise rate drops from about 3 g/s to about 0.25 g/s).
expectations.comment: Inside 1.6-2.4 g at 1.0-2.3 s, and growth is clearly stall-limited.

expectations.observed: q peaks at +21.7 deg/s at 1.1 s. theta is +27.1 deg at 2.1 s and +25.0 at 2.5 s. q stays positive until about 2.25 s (0.25 s after the stick returns), is positive again 2.6-4.1 s (up to +3.5 deg/s), and theta stays above +20 deg until 4 s. About 41 % of the disc stays stalled until 4.6 s.
expectations.comment: Inside +12..+35 deg/s and +12..+40 deg. No immediate recovery: a nose-up tendency persists while stalled.

expectations.observed: p is already -5.5..-8 deg/s before stall onset, then accelerates to -57.5 deg/s at 2.0 s. phi change: -34.8 deg (2.0 s), -59.5 (2.7 s, maximum), -55.6 (3 s), -39.6 (4 s), -20.9 (5 s). There is a dihedral-driven roll back right at about +20 deg/s from 2.9 s.
expectations.comment: Direction left is correct (medium confidence). The magnitude at 3-4 s is 5-25 deg beyond the -35 deg bound (low confidence). The card notes ask for directions and orders of magnitude only, so this is graded NEAR rather than FAIL.

expectations.observed: Stall begins at 0.5 s (1.42 g) and the stalled fraction reaches 0.41-0.46. The maximum is centred at azimuth 309 deg from the tail in the direction of rotation, i.e. the retreating left-front quadrant. No stall in trim.
expectations.comment: Inside 200-340 deg and grows from about 1.4 g. Radial extent is not recorded, so that part cannot be checked.

cards.headline: In a pushover to about 0.56 g the bearingless rotor keeps full roll control: right stick still gives a prompt, proportional right roll.

expectations.observed: nz minimum 0.562 g at 1.0 s, the end of the forward pulse.

With lat +0.15 at 1.006 s (nz 0.56, rising to 0.82 by 1.6 s), p peaks at +16.4 deg/s at 1.6 s from a coupled +6.2 deg/s at input. The 1 g reference (F3 scaled 1.5x) is about 16 deg/s at the same delay. The low-g/1 g ratio is 0.64 counting only the increment over the pre-input rate, 1.0 counting the total.
expectations.comment: Inside 8-17 deg/s and at least about 0.7 of the 1 g response on any reasonable accounting.

expectations.observed: Roll follows the right input with no reversal. Before the lateral input the pushover itself rolls the aircraft right at up to 6.2 deg/s (phi +4.9 deg). That coupling scales linearly with F2 (2.0 deg/s for a 3x smaller input at 0.85 g), so it is control/pitch-rate coupling rather than low-g loss of control.
expectations.comment: No loss of roll control at low g (high confidence).

expectations.observed: q minimum -9.38 deg/s at 0.6 s; theta minimum -7.65 deg at 1.2 s.

cards.headline: The 30-degree banked turn at 100 kt is kinematically exact and needs 9 % more power. With the ball centred the sideslip is a little over 3 degrees.

expectations.observed: Heading slope over 15-45 s is 6.23 deg/s (g tan30/V at 101.5 kt TAS = 6.21).
expectations.comment: Inside 6.1-6.5 deg/s.
Inside 1.14-1.17 g.

expectations.observed: 367.2 kW against 337.1 kW level: +8.9 % (+30 kW).
expectations.comment: Inside +6..+18 %.

expectations.observed: beta = +3.55 deg with ay = 0.002 m/s^2 (ball centred). Level flight at 100 kt already trims at +3.41 deg with the ball centred (+3.78 at 80 kt).
expectations.comment: 0.55 deg over the 3 deg bound. This is a trim property of the model's fin/Fenestron side force, not of the turn.
